column5: What if a whale swallowed you?
A dark shadow rises from below.
A giant mouth opens around you.
Water crushes in from every side.
You can't tell up from down.
You think this is the end.
In twenty twenty-one, this happened to a lobster diver near Cape Cod.
A humpback whale scooped him up by accident.
About thirty seconds later, it spat him back out.
A humpback's throat is far too narrow to swallow a person.
Would you still swim with whales?
